newsitem.title: CHAD: Cholera kills 14 people in Chad's capital.
newsitem.headline: Cholera kills 14 people in Chad's capital.

text.p: Cholera has killed 14 people in Chad's capital N'Djamena, the arid and impoverished African country's public health minister said.
Younouss Kedallah announced the toll on state radio on Friday.
Health officials blamed a fire at a power generating unit belonging to the state water and electricity company, saying it had disrupted supplies of drinking water in parts of the city.
Chad is often plagued by cholera outbreaks but these usually occur in August at the height of the rainy season.
